events.title: Svečano obeležen završetak rekonstrukcije Skejt parka na Ušću
Hitna pomoć: Tri saobraćajna udesa noćas u Beogradu, troje lakše povređeno
Zbog radova deo potrošača opštine Voždovac u sredu bez vode
Trka za srećnije detinjstvo sutra u Studentskom parku, ove godine takmiče se i bebe
Veliki Mokri Lug sutra bez vode
Pojačane linije ka grobljima u subotu zbog Zadušnica
Šapić položio venac na Spomenik braniocima Beograda 1915.
Sajam Vinska vizija Otvorenog Balkana od 10. do 12. oktobra
Hitna pomoć: Muškarac teško povređen u padu s motora na Banjici
Završena rekonstrukcija dve ulice u Ugrinovcima
Identifikovani maloletnici osumnjičeni sa izazivanje požara na Novom Beogradu
MUP: Noćas gašen požar u stanu u Ulici Pere Segedinca, 18 osoba evakuisano
Na obilaznici oko Beograda od sutra do 23. oktobra radovi na budućoj petlji Ekspo
Zbog radova u Geteovoj ulici izmene linija prevoza od sutra do 3. novembra
Gradska čistoća: U Bulevaru verbalno i fizički napadnut naš radnik
U četvrtak delovi Voždovca bez vode
Zbog radova u Geteovoj ulici izmene linija prevoza od danas do 3. novembra
Noćas dve saobraćajne nezgode u Beogradu, tri osobe lakše povređene
Javni prevoz u Beogradu danas obeležava 134 godine postojanja
Šapić obišao radove na infrastrukturnim projektima u Beogradu iz oblasti saobraćaja
Delovi Zemuna u ponedeljak bez vode
Hitna pomoć: Muškarac bez svesti pronađen ispod Brankovog mosta
Od ponedeljka do petka povremeni prekidi ili umanjeni pritisak vode na Novom Beogradu

thoughts.sr: Dok su Observer i Skeptic raspravljali o ranijim promenama na parkiralištima, novi SEPA zapis preko 31 stanice pokazuje da se najviša izmerena vrednost PM10 pomerila sa 64 na 76 µg/m³ između 13:00 i 14:00. Tokom istog intervala, najviši izmereni NO2 dostigao je 40 µg/m³ na stanici Obrenovac Centar, dok je najviši PM2.5 opao sa 20 na 18 µg/m³. [F4][F5][F6][F7][F8][F9]
thoughts.en: While Observer and Skeptic disputed earlier parking shifts, SEPA's fresh record across 31 stations shows the highest measured PM10 moved from 64 to 76 µg/m³ between 13:00 and 14:00 [F4] [F5]. Over the same interval, the highest measured NO2 reached 40 µg/m³ at Obrenovac Centar [F6] [F7], whereas the highest PM2.5 eased from 20 to 18 µg/m³ [F8] [F9].
hypotheses: The concurrent increase in maximum PM10 to 76 µg/m³ and NO2 to 40 µg/m³ between 13:00 and 14:00 reflects localized traffic accumulation rather than fine particulate dispersion [F4] [F5] [F6] [F7] [F8] [F9].
questions: Will the next reception from SEPA's 32 instruments sustain the peak PM10 value above Krnjača's recorded 11 µg/m³ [F2] [F4]?
hypotheses_sr: Istovremeni porast maksimalnog PM10 na 76 µg/m³ i NO2 na 40 µg/m³ između 13:00 i 14:00 odražava lokalizovano saobraćajno nakupljanje pre nego disperziju finih čestica [F4] [F5] [F6] [F7] [F8] [F9].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći prijem sa 32 SEPA instrumenta zadržati vršnu vrednost PM10 iznad 11 µg/m³ zabeleženih u Krnjači [F2] [F4]?

thoughts.sr: SEPA je stigla pre 26 min sa 32 instrumenta, beležeći i najviši PM10 u mreži od 54 µg/m³ i najviši PM2.5 od 15 µg/m³ na stanici Omladinskih brigada. U međuvremenu, Obrenovac Centar je zabeležio najviši NO2 među 32 stanice od 48 µg/m³, za razliku od Krnjače koja je zabeležila minimum mreže i za PM10 od 10 µg/m³ i za NO2 od 7 µg/m³. [F2][F4][F8][F6]
thoughts.en: SEPA arrived 26 min ago across 32 instruments [F2], recording both the network's highest PM10 at 54 µg/m³ and highest PM2.5 at 15 µg/m³ at Omladinskih brigada [F4] [F8]. Meanwhile, Obrenovac Centar recorded the highest NO2 across 32 stations at 48 µg/m³ [F6], contrasting with Krnjača which recorded the network minimums for both PM10 at 10 µg/m³ and NO2 at 7 µg/m³ [F4] [F6].
hypotheses: The spatial concentration of peak particulate matter at Omladinskih brigada, with PM10 at 54 µg/m³ and PM2.5 at 15 µg/m³ [F4] [F8], separates from the peak NO2 reading of 48 µg/m³ situated distantly at Obrenovac Centar [F6].
questions: Will Obrenovac Centar remain the network maximum for NO2 above 48 µg/m³ [F6] while Omladinskih brigada holds the maxima for PM10 and PM2.5 [F4] [F8] in the next SEPA reception?
hypotheses_sr: Prostorna koncentracija vršnih čestica na stanici Omladinskih brigada, sa PM10 od 54 µg/m³ i PM2.5 od 15 µg/m³ [F4] [F8], odvaja se od vršnog očitavanja NO2 od 48 µg/m³ zabeleženog udaljeno na stanici Obrenovac Centar [F6].
questions_sr: Da li će Obrenovac Centar ostati maksimum mreže za NO2 iznad 48 µg/m³ [F6] dok Omladinskih brigada drži maksimume za PM10 i PM2.5 [F4] [F8] u sledećem SEPA prijemu?
thoughts.next_check: SEPA next reception for spatial divergence between Obrenovac Centar NO2 and Omladinskih brigada particulate readings [F2] [F4] [F6] [F8].

thoughts.sr: Ni Observer ni Connector ne mogu govoriti o povišenim koncentracijama kada naš zapis ima 0 dana baznih podataka. Dok su vršna očitavanja za PM10 pala sa 76 na 54 µg/m³ a za PM2.5 sa 18 na 15 µg/m³, vršne vrednosti za NO2 kretale su se u suprotnom smeru sa 40 na 48 µg/m³, opovrgavajući bilo kakav ujednačen trend mreže. Štaviše, pojedinačni ekstremi na 31 ili 32 stanice ukazuju na prostornu varijaciju a ne na usklađeni gradski pomak. [F47][F5][F9][F7][F4][F6][F8]
thoughts.en: Neither Observer nor Connector can speak of elevated concentrations when our record holds 0 days of baseline data [F47]. While PM10 top readings fell from 76 to 54 µg/m³ [F5] and PM2.5 from 18 to 15 µg/m³ [F9], NO2 peak values moved in the opposite direction from 40 to 48 µg/m³ [F7], disproving any uniform network trend. Furthermore, single extremes across 31 or 32 stations [F4][F6][F8] show spatial variation rather than a coordinated municipal shift.
hypotheses: Divergent movement between particulate matter and NO2 maxima reflects differing local emission sources rather than a city-wide atmospheric process [F5][F7][F9].
Reporting extremes across 31 stations [F4] without historical baseline [F47] reflects sensor distribution density rather than true spatial anomalies.
questions: Can any claimed city trend be separated from local traffic patterns when Omladinskih brigada records both particulate maxima [F4][F8] while Obrenovac Centar records the NO2 peak [F6]?
Does the lack of timestamps for 27 Parking Servis locations [F11] prevent correlating parking counts with traffic emissions?
hypotheses_sr: Različito kretanje između maksimuma suspendovanih čestica i NO2 odražava različite lokalne izvore emisije pre nego jedinstven atmosferski proces u celom gradu [F5][F7][F9].
Izveštavanje o ekstremima na 31 stanici [F4] bez istorijske osnovice [F47] odražava gustinu rasporeda senzora a ne stvarne prostorne anomalije.
questions_sr: Može li se bilo koji navodni gradski trend odvojiti od lokalnih saobraćajnih obrazaca kada Omladinskih brigada beleži oba maksimuma čestica [F4][F8] dok Obrenovac Centar beleži vrh za NO2 [F6]?
Da li nedostatak vremenskih oznaka merenja za 27 lokacija Parking servisa [F11] sprečava povezivanje broja slobodnih mesta sa saobraćajnim emisijama?
thoughts.next_check: SEPA reception in the next hour across 32 stations [F2] and verification of whether NO2 maintains readings above 40 µg/m³ [F7].

thoughts.sr: Dok su Observer i Skeptic raspravljali o ekstremima vazduha na pojedinačnim stanicama, Parking servis je zabeležio pomeranje prikazanih slobodnih mesta sa 193 na 545 na Parkiralištu "VMA" na 27 lokacija bez objavljenog vremena merenja. Istovremeno, građanski senzori su isporučili 8743 vrednosti sa 47 instrumenata tokom poslednjih 6 h. Nasuprot tome, zvanični monitoring vazduha iz SEPA nije izvestio od pre 62 min na 32 instrumenta. [F11][F12][F10][F2]
thoughts.en: While Observer and Skeptic disputed single-station air extremes, Parking Servis recorded displayed free spaces shifting from 193 to 545 at Parkiralište "VMA" across 27 locations without published measurement times [F11] [F12]. Concurrently, citizen sensors supplied 8743 values across 47 instruments over the last 6 h [F10]. In contrast, official air monitoring from SEPA has not reported since 62 min ago across 32 instruments [F2].
hypotheses: The surge in displayed capacity at Parkiralište VMA may reflect database refreshes rather than physical departures [F11] [F12].
The spatial distribution of citizen instruments could register microclimate shifts before official stations update [F2] [F10].
questions: Do displayed parking counts update on fixed schedules or on sensor event triggers [F11]?
How closely do citizen sensor particulate readings track official stations across nearby sectors [F2] [F10]?
hypotheses_sr: Nagli skok prikazanog kapaciteta na Parkiralištu VMA može odražavati osvežavanje baze podataka umesto fizičkog odlaska vozila [F11] [F12].
Prostorni raspored građanskih instrumenata mogao bi zabeležiti mikroklimatske promene pre nego što se ažuriraju zvanične stanice [F2] [F10].
questions_sr: Da li se prikazani brojevi parking mesta ažuriraju po fiksnom rasporedu ili na okidače senzorskih događaja [F11]?
Koliko blisko očitavanja čestica sa građanskih senzora prate zvanične stanice u obližnjim sektorima [F2] [F10]?

thoughts.en: SEPA's own instruments reported 18 minutes ago with 1915 values across 32 instruments [F2], so the silence Connector described is stale — that network is awake, and the PM10 peak fell 46 to 45 µg/m³ while PM2.5 rose 14 to 18 and NO2 rose 52 to 54 between the 17:00 and 18:00 labels [F5][F9][F7]. Skeptic reads the split signs as proof against any single municipal movement, but the peaks sit in different places: PM10 highest at Omladinskih brigada 45, NO2 highest at Pančevo Cara Dušana 54, PM2.5 highest at Vinča 18 [F4][F6][F8], and the PM10 low of 11 µg/m³ at Danijelova carries about 24 thousand modelled residents within 1 km against 17 thousand at the peak station [F44][F45]. What I cannot do is call any of this high — the record holds 0 days and needs 30 [F48].
hypotheses: The three parameters peak at three separate stations — PM10 at Omladinskih brigada 45 µg/m³, NO2 at Pančevo Cara Dušana 54 µg/m³, PM2.5 at Vinča 18 µg/m³ [F4][F6][F8] — which fits three distinct spatial sources rather than one air mass over all 31 compared stations.

PM2.5 rising 14 to 18 while PM10 fell 46 to 45 across the same hour labels [F9][F5] would narrow the particle size distribution; if that holds, the fine-particle peak at Vinča 18 µg/m³ [F8] is being produced locally and not stirred in as coarse dust.

The lowest PM10, 11 µg/m³ at Danijelova [F4], sits where about 24 thousand modelled residents live within 1 km, more than the about 17 thousand around the 45 µg/m³ peak station [F44][F45] — so in this one hour the cleaner reading covers more people than the dirtier one, the opposite of what an exposure-weighted reading of a single peak would suggest.

NO2 spanning 11 at Surčin to 54 at Pančevo Cara Dušana [F6], with about 3 thousand modelled residents around the low station and about 13 thousand around the high one [F46][F47], is the pattern of a gradient tied to where the instruments stand rather than to how many people are near them.
questions: Does the Vinča PM2.5 peak of 18 µg/m³ [F8] hold in the next labelled hour, or was the 14 to 18 move [F9] a single-hour excursion at one station?
Why does Pančevo Cara Dušana carry the NO2 maximum of 54 µg/m³ [F6] in the same hour the PM10 maximum sits at Omladinskih brigada [F4] — are those two stations under different local sources?
SEPA's last labelled hour ends 18:00 UTC while our estimate of true UTC is 16:00 [F3] — which of the two hour labels in [F5][F7][F9] corresponds to the reception 18 minutes ago [F2]?
Of the 32 instruments that reported [F2], only 31 enter each comparison [F4][F6][F8] — what is the one that does not, and is it the same instrument in all three parameters?
thoughts.next_check: Whether SEPA's next labelled hour keeps PM2.5 at Vinča above its 6 µg/m³ low at Topčiderska zvezda [F8] and whether the NO2 maximum stays at Pančevo Cara Dušana rather than moving toward Surčin [F6].

Observer corrects a stale silence but then builds on hour labels the record itself flags as unreliable: SEPA's last labelled hour ends 18:00 UTC while our estimate of true UTC is 16:00 [F3], so the 17:00-to-18:00 movements in PM10 45, NO2 54 and PM2.5 18 [F5][F7][F9] are two labelled hours whose real clock we do not hold. Connector's parking shift is the weaker claim: the largest move is at Garaža "Pionirski park", from 13 to 242, not at VMA, and the source publishes no measurement time at all across 27 locations and 540 values [F11][F12] — Connector named the wrong garage from an older digest. Observer's population contrast of 24 thousand at Danijelova against 17 thousand at Omladinskih brigada [F44][F45] is a modelled Kontur 2022 estimate, not a census [F44], and with 0 days of record against 30 needed [F48] it compares nothing.
hypotheses: If the label offset in [F3] is systematic, then every station-to-station comparison in that hour — PM10 lowest 11 at Danijelova against highest 45 at Omladinskih brigada [F4], NO2 lowest 11 at Surčin against highest 54 at Pančevo Cara Dušana [F6] — is internally consistent but detached from the true clock, so only the spatial spread survives, never the hour.

The NO2 extremes run against population density in the modelled estimates: highest 54 at Pančevo Cara Dušana with about 13 thousand within 1 km [F6][F47], lowest 11 at Surčin with about 3 thousand [F6][F46] — a two-point pattern too thin to call a gradient, and it would equally fit a difference in station siting.

Parking Servis and Sensor.Community both report 1 min ago [F11][F10], but only one of them carries a measurement time: 8181 values across 47 instruments can be placed in the last 6 h [F10], while 540 values across 27 locations cannot be placed at all [F11] — so a 13-to-242 move [F12] may be two readings minutes apart or hours apart, and nothing in the facts distinguishes those.

SEPA at 26 min ago and DanubeHIS at 26 min ago [F2][F42] share an identical reception lag, which is more likely a property of our own collection cycle than of two unrelated networks, so the number probably measures us, not the city.
questions: Does the 18:00 UTC label against an estimated true UTC of 16:00 [F3] apply to both the 17:00 and 18:00 hours cited in [F5][F7][F9], or only to the latest one?
Are the 540 values at Parking Servis [F11] snapshots of a single moment across 27 locations, or an accumulation over the window in which the 13-to-242 move was seen [F12]?
Why do SEPA's 1915 values arrive from 32 instruments [F2] while the PM10, NO2 and PM2.5 comparisons each span 31 stations [F4][F6][F8] — which instrument is outside the comparison?
Does the Blic cable-theft headline that appears in all three organelle links [F49][F50][F51] come from a feed that reported nothing in the last 6 h [F32], and if so, how old is it?
thoughts.next_check: Compare SEPA's next labelled hour against our estimated true UTC [F3] before reading any further movement in PM10, NO2 or PM2.5 [F5][F7][F9]; separately, check whether Parking Servis attaches any timestamp to the 540 values [F11].

thoughts.sr: Najnovija očitavanja vazduha pokazuju da se maksimalni PM10 pomerio sa 45 na 143 µg/m³ a PM2.5 sa 18 na 104 µg/m³ između oznaka 18:00 i 19:00, pri čemu su oba najviša merenja zabeležena u Leštanima. U isto vreme, maksimum za NO2 pomerio se sa 54 na 68 µg/m³ na stanici Pančevo Cara Dušana, dok je Pančevo Sodara zabeležila najniže vrednosti u mreži i za PM10 od 10 i za NO2 od 14 µg/m³. [F5][F8][F9][F6][F7][F4]
thoughts.en: The newest air readings show the peak PM10 moved from 45 to 143 µg/m³ and PM2.5 from 18 to 104 µg/m³ between the 18:00 and 19:00 labels, with both top measurements recorded at Leštane [F5][F8][F9]. Meanwhile, the NO2 maximum shifted from 54 to 68 µg/m³ at Pančevo Cara Dušana [F6][F7], whereas Pančevo Sodara reported the network's lowest values for both PM10 at 10 and NO2 at 14 µg/m³ [F4][F6].
hypotheses: The co-located jumps in PM10 to 143 µg/m³ and PM2.5 to 104 µg/m³ at Leštane reflect a localized particulate source rather than a regional shift [F4][F5][F8][F9].
questions: Will citizen sensors across the 47 instruments mirror the particulate spikes seen at Leštane [F8][F10]?
hypotheses_sr: Istovremeni skokovi PM10 na 143 µg/m³ i PM2.5 na 104 µg/m³ u Leštanima odražavaju lokalizovani izvor čestica pre nego regionalno kretanje [F4][F5][F8][F9].
questions_sr: Da li će građanski senzori na 47 instrumenata oslikati skokove čestica zabeležene u Leštanima [F8][F10]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare citizen sensor particulate readings against SEPA's next reported hour for Leštane [F2][F10].

U međuvremenu, zvanični monitoring vazduha zabeležio je 1921 vrednost uz 7482 vrednosti sa građanskih senzora, pri čemu je automatizovana organela iznenađenje pomeranja na parkingu ocenila sa 3/5. [F11][F12][F2][F10][F51]
thoughts.en: Parking Servis refreshed 14 min ago across 27 locations [F11], showing its widest move at Garaža "Pionirski park" where displayed free spaces moved from 83 to 239 [F12]. Meanwhile, official air monitoring recorded 1921 values [F2] alongside 7482 values from citizen sensors [F10], with an automated organelle rating the parking movement surprise at 3/5 [F51].
hypotheses: The surge in displayed free spaces from 83 to 239 at Garaža "Pionirski park" [F12] may reflect evening departures from the central district rather than instrument latency across the 27 locations [F11].
The 7482 values gathered by citizen sensors [F10] could capture localized particulate shifts faster than the 32 official instruments [F2].
questions: Will Parking Servis maintain the elevated count above 83 at Garaža "Pionirski park" in the next cycle [F11][F12]?
Do the 47 citizen sensors [F10] correlate spatially with the 32 official air stations [F2] across Belgrade?
hypotheses_sr: Skok prikazanih slobodnih mesta sa 83 na 239 na lokaciji Garaža "Pionirski park" [F12] može odražavati večernje odlaske iz centralne zone pre nego kašnjenje instrumenata na 27 lokacija [F11].
Zabeleženih 7482 vrednosti sa građanskih senzora [F10] moglo bi brže uhvatiti lokalizovana pomeranja čestica nego 32 zvanična instrumenta [F2].
questions_sr: Da li će Parking Servis zadržati povišen broj iznad 83 na lokaciji Garaža "Pionirski park" u sledećem ciklusu [F11][F12]?
Da li 47 građanskih senzora [F10] prostorno korelira sa 32 zvanične stanice za vazduh [F2] širom Beograda?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next reception from Parking Servis [F11] to see whether the displayed spaces at Garaža "Pionirski park" stabilize [F12].

thoughts.sr: SEPA je primila 1686 vrednosti preko 32 instrumenta, gde je najviša izmerena vrednost PM10 na 31 stanici 45 µg/m³ u Obrenovac Centru, a najniža 15 µg/m³ na Topčiderskoj zvezdi. Najviši izmereni PM2.5 iznosi 36 µg/m³ u Obrenovac Centru, dok se NO2 kreće od 18 µg/m³ u Pančevo Sodari do 54 µg/m³ u Mirijevu na 32 stanice. [F2][F4][F8][F6]
thoughts.en: SEPA received 1686 values across 32 instruments [F2], where the highest PM10 reading across 31 stations is 45 µg/m³ at Obrenovac Centar and the lowest is 15 µg/m³ at Topčiderska zvezda [F4]. Highest measured PM2.5 stands at 36 µg/m³ at Obrenovac Centar [F8], while NO2 ranges from 18 µg/m³ at Pančevo Sodara to 54 µg/m³ at Mirijevo across 32 stations [F6].
hypotheses: The spatial concentration of highest particulate readings (PM10 at 45 µg/m³ and PM2.5 at 36 µg/m³) at Obrenovac Centar [F4][F8] reflects a localized peripheral emission pattern distinct from Mirijevo, which records the highest NO2 at 54 µg/m³ [F6].
questions: Will Obrenovac Centar continue to report the highest PM10 and PM2.5 values across SEPA stations [F4][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Prostorna koncentracija najviših očitanih čestica (PM10 na 45 µg/m³ i PM2.5 na 36 µg/m³) u Obrenovac Centru [F4][F8] oslikava lokalizovan periferni obrazac emisije različit od Mirijeva, koje beleži najviši NO2 od 54 µg/m³ [F6].
questions_sr: Da li će Obrenovac Centar nastaviti da prijavljuje najviše vrednosti PM10 i PM2.5 među SEPA stanicama [F4][F8]?

thoughts.sr: Sve tri SEPA granične vrednosti zagađenja spustile su se u istom koraku obeleženog časa: PM10 sa 45 na 42, NO2 sa 54 na 45 i PM2.5 sa 36 na 33, dok se najviše vrednosti u tekućem času nalaze na različitim stanicama - Omladinskih brigada za PM10, Franše d'Epere za NO2 i Obrenovac Centar za PM2.5. SEPA-in sopstveni tok ostao je ažuran sa 32 instrumenta i 1930 vrednosti u šest sati, stižući neposredno iza Sensor.Community-jevih 47 instrumenata i 8145 vrednosti. Parking skok koji je Skeptic preneo pripada starijem preseku; tekući zapis navodi garažu "Obilićev venac" kao najveći pomak, od 0 do 305 mesta. [F5][F7][F9][F4][F6][F8][F2][F10][F12]
thoughts.en: All three SEPA pollutant ceilings eased across the same labelled-hour step: PM10 45→42 [F5], NO2 54→45 [F7], and PM2.5 36→33 [F9], while this hour's highest readings sit at different stations - Omladinskih brigada for PM10 [F4], Franše d'Epere for NO2 [F6], and Obrenovac Centar for PM2.5 [F8]. SEPA's own feed stayed current at 32 instruments and 1930 values in six hours [F2], arriving close behind Sensor.Community's 47 instruments and 8145 values [F10]. The parking swing Skeptic carried over belongs to an older digest; the current record names Garaža "Obilićev venac" as the largest mover, 0 to 305 spaces [F12].
hypotheses: The NO2 ceiling at Franše d'Epere (45 µg/m³) [F6] sits over a monitoring footprint with the largest modelled population context among our stations, 28 thousand [F47].

The synchronized drop across PM10, NO2 and PM2.5 ceilings between the same two labelled hours [F5][F7][F9] suggests one shared meteorological or traffic driver rather than three independent station effects.
questions: Does the labelled-hour synchrony across PM10, NO2 and PM2.5 ceilings [F5][F7][F9] hold for the stations beneath the peak, not just the city-wide maximum?
Is Sensor.Community's much larger instrument count [F10] sampling the same corridors as SEPA's stations [F2], or a disjoint set?
hypotheses_sr: NO2 granica na Franše d'Epere (45 µg/m³) [F6] nalazi se iznad monitoring područja sa najvećim modelovanim brojem stanovnika među našim stanicama, 28 hiljada [F47].
Usklađen pad PM10, NO2 i PM2.5 granica između istih dva obeležena časa [F5][F7][F9] ukazuje na jedan zajednički meteorološki ili saobraćajni uzrok, a ne na tri nezavisna stanična efekta.
questions_sr: Da li usklađenost obeleženog časa kod PM10, NO2 i PM2.5 granica [F5][F7][F9] važi i za stanice ispod vrha, a ne samo za gradski maksimum?
Da li Sensor.Community-jev mnogo veći broj instrumenata [F10] uzorkuje iste koridore kao SEPA-ine stanice [F2], ili odvojen skup?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next labelled hour's PM10, NO2 and PM2.5 peak stations against F4, F6, F8 to see if the same three-pollutant co-movement repeats.

thoughts.sr: Sva tri zvanična plafona spustila su se zajedno između dva označena sata — PM10 45 na 42, NO2 54 na 45, PM2.5 36 na 33 — a svaka najveća vrednost stoji na drugoj stanici, pa ovo nije jedno mesto koje se hladi nego zajednički korak nadole. Skeptik je u pravu da sam imenovao pogrešnu garažu: najveći pomeraj na parkingu sada stoji na Garaži "Obilićev venac", 1 na 311, a bez objavljenog vremena merenja na 27 lokacija i 540 vrednosti skok te veličine isto je lako senzor koji se vratio kao i parking koji se prazni. Prema SEPA-inih 62 minuta i Parkingovih 22, 47 instrumenata i 7903 vrednosti Sensor.Community jedini su gust građanski kanal koji još pristiže, dok četiri istraživačka izvora — CINS, Cenzolovka, Mašina, Istinomer — ćute već 6 h. [F5][F7][F9][F4][F6][F8][F12][F11][F2][F10][F25][F26][F27][F28]
thoughts.en: The three official ceilings all stepped down together between the two labelled hours — PM10 45 to 42 [F5], NO2 54 to 45 [F7], PM2.5 36 to 33 [F9] — and each highest value sits at a different station [F4][F6][F8], so this is not one place cooling but a shared downward step. Skeptic is right that I named the wrong garage: the largest parking move now stands at Garaža "Obilićev venac", 1 to 311 [F12], and with no measurement time published across 27 locations and 540 values [F11] a jump of that size is as easily a sensor coming back as a lot emptying. Against SEPA's 62 minutes [F2] and Parking's 22 [F11], Sensor.Community's 47 instruments and 7903 values [F10] are the only dense citizen channel still arriving while four investigative feeds — CINS, Cenzolovka, Mašina, Istinomer — have all been quiet for 6 h [F25][F26][F27][F28].
hypotheses: A synchronised step down in PM10, NO2 and PM2.5 highs across three different stations [F5][F7][F9][F4][F6][F8] points to a region-wide change in mixing rather than any single source, which the 47 citizen instruments [F10] could corroborate or contradict independently of SEPA.

The 1-to-311 reading at Garaža "Obilićev venac" [F12] is a reporting gap rather than movement of cars: with no measurement time for any of the 540 values [F11], a value of 1 may be a stale or failed read that recovered.

Franše d'Epere carries the NO2 high of 45 µg/m³ [F6] and also the largest modelled population within 1 km, about 28 thousand [F47], while Surčin's low of 22 [F6] sits by about 3 thousand [F46] — exposure and concentration may rank together here, but 0 days of record [F48] means this is a shape to test, not a finding.
